resolutions.rationale: Valid, and measured. The three root JSON blocks are shown with 2-space indentation while `biome.json` sets `indentStyle: "tab"` and lists them in `files.includes`; the only format pass the record names (`biome check --write src tests`, R3) skips them. Copied verbatim, `biome check .` fails on `biome.json`, `package.json` and `tsconfig.json` before any `src/` reflow is considered. Biome also collapses `files.includes` onto one line at width 120 (the critic's 'probably' is confirmed), while `pi.extensions` stays expanded. `vitest.config.ts` is already tab-indented and passes. The fix is wording plus widening the one-time pass to the whole allowlist: `biome check --write .` fixed exactly seven files (the four `src/` files R3 named plus the three JSON configs) and the tree was clean afterwards. No new script or config value.

resolutions.target_artifact: openspec/changes/foundation-and-packaging/design.md — Decision 6, manual load check (lines 191–209: the prerequisites, the command block and the two negative controls); Risks 2 (line 339)
resolutions.rationale: Valid, and I weigh it major rather than minor: the `git checkout -- <file>` revert I specified in COMP-2 discards uncommitted work. In the normal Implement flow Derek's tree is dirty with the no-op edits when he first runs the manual check, so Control A's revert silently throws away his `session-tree.ts` edit. After Migration step 2, Control A in the live tree also breaks every Pi session on the machine for the duration (Risks 2). Both go away if the check runs against a throwaway copy of HEAD — which is exactly how every measurement in this record (orientation, R6, COMP-1/COMP-2, this round) was made. The copy also makes the stated 'clean tree' precondition unnecessary: the check verifies committed state by construction, so tasks must order it after the stub-edit commit.
resolutions.evidence: michael-resolve-s1s2.json COMP-2 required_change introduced `git checkout -- <file>`; `git checkout -- <path>` on a modified tracked file discards the working-tree change without prompt (git semantics). Every manual-check measurement in this record ran in `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C <mktemp>`: orientation Trap 1/3, R6, COMP-1/COMP-2 (both controls, zero dirty files), and this round (positive run, control A → 1 match, control B → 1 match, no install needed). design.md:339 Risks 2 names the every-session failure mode.
resolutions.required_change:
Replace the command block and the two controls in Decision 6 with a copy-based procedure:

  Prerequisites unchanged (Node 26.8.1, npm 11.19.0, Pi 1.5.2 via `pi --version`, `rg`). The check runs against a throwaway copy of the committed tree, never the live checkout, so it needs no clean-tree precondition and no revert; commit the stub edits first.

  ```
  D=$(mktemp -d)
  git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$D"
  printf '{"packages":[%s]}' "$(node -p 'JSON.stringify(process.argv[1])' "$D")" > "$D/settings.json"
  PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR="$D" pi --no-session --help > "$D/out.txt" 2>&1
  head -1 "$D/out.txt"
  rg -c 'Failed to load extension|Host-provided extension packages' "$D/out.txt"
  ```

  (`$D` is both the package root Pi loads and the throwaway agent directory; Pi reads only `settings.json` from the agent directory and only `package.json` and `pi.extensions` from the package, so sharing one directory is safe.) Pass rule unchanged: usage header printed; `rg -c` prints nothing and exits 1; both controls print `1`.

  - Control A: in `$D/src/infra/pi-event-handlers/session-tree.ts` replace `_pi.on("session_tree", () => {});` with `throw new Error("Not implemented: registerSessionTreeHandler");`, re-run the `pi` line, `rg -c 'Failed to load extension' "$D/out.txt"` → `1`. Undo by re-extracting: `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$D"`.
  - Control B: in `$D/package.json` add `"dependencies": { "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": "*" }`; no `npm install`; re-run the `pi` line, `rg -c 'Host-provided extension packages' "$D/out.txt"` → `1`. Undo by re-extracting as above.

  Cleanup: `rm -rf "$D"`. The live checkout is never read by Pi and never modified. Record `pi --version` with the result.

Risks 2: append 'The manual check never loads the live checkout (Decision 6 runs against a `git archive` copy), so re-running it after step 2 cannot trip this.'
